lead.description: a joint probability specification for the observations and the unknowns

self_checks.title: Joint probability of a success
self_checks.prompt: Prior probability 1/2 on success probability 0.2, and one Bernoulli trial. What is the joint probability of that value and a success?

self_checks.title: Posterior after a failure
self_checks.prompt: Under the same two-point model, with prior 1/2 on 0.2 and on 0.8, the trial is a failure. What is the posterior probability of 0.2?

overview_sentence: A [Bayesian model](articles/bayesian-model.qmd) is a joint probability specification for the observations and the unknowns.
